card.name: Linking words before early-life or past-exposure terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (as, of, have, in) and the end of 'antidepressants' where the next words likely name a time period of life or past exposure, such as children, in utero, or history of.

modes.label: Before life-stage words
modes.description: The word 'as' or 'in' comes right before a life stage such as children or utero.

modes.label: After 'history'
modes.description: The word 'of' follows history or histories, leading into a past exposure or screening.

modes.label: Past-event questions
modes.description: A verb like 'have' in a past-history question that continues into an earlier episode.
modes.example: - Did you<< have>> an episode of choking
